about: Steam games with EasyAntiCheat (or, with antiCheat BattlEye, BattlEye) that run offline without it when their exe is started directly with steam_appid.txt (the Steam app id) beside it: the only games SCSKiller offers an offline recording session for. A BattlEye session's signed scskiller.ini carries offline=battleye, the only stamp the recorder leaves BattlEye's file names out for; its client module still refuses. exe: the file the game's Steam id is discovered with. eacProductId and eacSandboxId: the productid and sandboxid in the Settings.json of the EasyAntiCheat folder beside that exe; a copy added by hand qualifies only with this exe and both ids, a game listed without them only as the store's copy. Elden Ring Nightreign has an offline mode but no source confirms this launch, so it isn't listed.
